exposure: Hysteroscopic intact removal technique (using a 5-mm Bettocchi hysteroscope or a 3.5-mm Versascope hysteroscope)
Medical therapy with multiple-dose methotrexate (prior unsuccessful treatment)
cohort: Four patients diagnosed with angular or cesarean scar pregnancies who underwent hysteroscopic intact removal treatment at the department between January 2000 and December 2018.
finding: Hysteroscopic intact removal of angular and cesarean scar pregnancies achieved a 100% success rate and 0% complication rate in this small case series, suggesting it may be a safe and effective minimally invasive treatment option.
mod_finding: The study evaluated a treatment for cesarean scar pregnancies, a condition directly resulting from a previous mode of birth (C-section).
